summary: Backend + Frontend testing of UNIFIED WALLET SYSTEM. All 9 new pytest cases in test_unified_wallet.py PASS (equality of wallet_summary total_usdt == wallet_usdt == bot_wallet_balance; deposit disabled; withdraw address-required; external withdraw deducts unified balance + cancel refund; wrong password 401; fresh user activate 400; P2P email funds new user then activation succeeds and admin bot wallet gets revenue txn; P2P by address). Frontend: hero balances match across Dashboard/Wallet/BotHub (all $106.76), Dashboard/Wallet action buttons deep-link to /bot?action=deposit|withdraw|p2p and auto-open the correct modal, BotHub Deposit modal is crypto-only (tab-deposit-main and tab-deposit-crypto testids GONE, BEP20/Polygon/TRC20-Soon network cards + QR visible), Withdraw modal only has External flow with address+password+'Submit Withdrawal Request' text (no 'Main Wallet' text), Wallet History renders bot wallet txns (p2p received, p2p sent, revenue, withdraw refund, withdraw request, bot fuel, trade commission). Admin withdrawals + Referral + Rank pages load without errors.

issues: Positive amounts render without a '+' prefix (e.g., Trade Commission shows '$2.83'), while negative ones already carry the '-' sign. Sign styling logic at Wallet.jsx:437-490 uses `h.type` (deposit/withdraw) which never matches bot txn kinds like p2p_received / revenue / trade_commission, so isIn/isOut are always false and the '+' sign is never prepended. Cosmetic only — amount value itself is correct.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) In /app/frontend/src/pages/Wallet.jsx history renderer, derive the sign from `h.amount` (or bot txn kind whitelist) instead of `h.type === 'deposit'` so credits show a green '+' prefix.

(Housekeeping) /app/backend/tests/test_bot_wallet.py still asserts pre-unified behavior (main->bot deposit succeeds, internal withdraw returns 200, activation deducts from main wallet). Those tests are now outdated and will fail — recommend deleting the file or updating to match unified rules. This iteration's new test_unified_wallet.py fully replaces its coverage of the changed endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet_summary at server.py:1546 correctly forces total_usdt == wallet_usdt == bot_wallet_balance in demo mode (line 1603-1605). Field `demo_wallet_usdt` is still returned as a debug/backing value; it is NOT surfaced anywhere in the UI (verified) — this is fine but the payload could be trimmed to avoid confusion.

bot_wallet_withdraw at server.py:2240 checks balance BEFORE address+password — so a caller with insufficient balance sees 'Insufficient bot wallet balance' even if they also omitted the address. Not a bug, but slightly misleading. Consider re-ordering to validate inputs first.

BotHub.jsx auto-open effect at line 113-120 calls setSearchParams({}, { replace: true }) which strips ?action= after mount. This is intentional but means the URL shown in the browser after the deep-link no longer reflects state (both /wallet Deposit and /home Deposit end up at /bot). Acceptable UX.
